# dsh-notify
English | 中文

**Cross-device notifications for DeepSeek Harness.** No attendance is required
while a long task run

s: when the turn ends, or waits for your approval or answer, a
notification goes out through the cha

nnels you enabled — a desktop toast, a browser tab,
an ntfy push to your phone, a Feishu bot message
, in any combination.

- Settings → **Notifications**: pick channels, paste the credentials, press **Send test**
- Four cha

nnels: the OS notification centre (macOS / Windows / Linux), your own browser
tab, ntfy, and a Feish

u bot
- Only when you have stepped away: every message waits for an idle window (60 s by
default) an

d is dropped if you act inside it — reply, approve, answer — or if you are
already reading the reply

: once the turn ends, a scroll, a click or a keystroke in that
conversation is a read receipt, and t

he message stays unsent
- Secrets stay in the Host credential seam, never in the configuration file
## Screenshots
## Channels
| Channel | Delivery | Credential |

| `local` | Notification Center on macOS, a toast on Windows, `notify-send` on Linux | none |
| `bro

wser` | a system notification from the open GUI tab | browser permission |
| `ntfy` | ntfy publish A

PI | topic + optional token |
| `feishu` | Feishu/Lark custom-bot webhook | webhook prefix + token,
optional sign secret |
## Install
### 1. Through the Host's `installBundle` (installs **and** enables)
Ask the agent in a conversation:
> install the plugin `github:miiy/dsh-notify`
or paste the same spec into the install field on **Settings → Plugins**.

Both call the Host's `installBundle`, which installs the package, adds it to
`dsh.profile.bundles`,
and hot-applies it — one step.
### 2. From the CLI (`dsh plugin`, installs only)
[代码示例省略，未执行]

`dsh plugin` forwards its arguments to pnpm inside the profile directory, so this step
installs the

package but does **not** compose it. The row then shows up on
**Settings → Plugins** as installed an

d switched **off**; turn it on to add it to
`dsh.profile.bundles`. If the switch does not take effec
t live, restart `dsh web`.

A plain-JavaScript bundle has no build script, so a git install needs no `allowBuilds`
approval.

Accepted spec forms: `github:user/repo`, `git+https://…`, a hosted repository URL, an
absolute local
path, or an npm package name.
### 3. From a local checkout (development)
See MAINTENANCE.md → *Run from a checkout*.
## Configure
Open **Settings → Notifications**.
| Field | Meaning |
| Channels | Desktop, Browser, ntfy, Feishu, any combination. A save is refused while an enabled cha

nnel's credential is missing. |
| Feishu bot | The prefix `https://open.feishu.cn/open-apis/bot/v2/h

ook/` is prefilled and editable; paste only the token that follows it. |
| Browser permission | One

click on **Allow notifications**; the page reports the state. |
| Turn completes | Notify on `comple

ted` / `error` / `max-tokens`; `aborted` (your own stop) is never offered. |
| Waiting for approval

| Notify when a tool call asks for a decision. |
| Waiting for an answer | Notify when the agent ask

s you a question. |
| Wait before sending | Seconds without input before a message leaves; `0` sends

at once. |
| Message text | One template per event, prefilled with the default text. First line is

the title, the rest is the body; **Restore** puts the default back. |
| Send test | Send one real me
ssage through that channel, using the **saved** values. |

Placeholders per event: `{title}` `{outcome}` `{project}` `{duration}` `{preview}`
`{error}` for a f

inished turn, `{title}` `{project}` `{tool}` `{reason}` for an approval,
`{title}` `{project}` `{que

stion}` `{count}` for a question. An unknown name stays in the
text.

Configuration is stored in `~/.dsh/dsh-notify/config.json` (mode 0600). Credentials go
through the H

ost credential seam, so the page is told whether a key is set, never its
value.
